\n\n保存新指纹会替换这条服务器的旧记录；只有确认服务器确实换过密钥时才保存。: Saving replaces the stored key for this server. Only do it when you know the server key really changed.
\n\n已有目标不会覆盖；下载文件夹会保留层级，符号链接和特殊文件会报错。: Existing destinations are never overwritten. Folder downloads preserve structure; symbolic links and special files produce an error.
\n\n文件夹将递归下载，保留层级和空目录。已有目标不会覆盖；符号链接和特殊文件: Folders download recursively, including empty folders. Existing destinations are never overwritten. Symbolic links and special files produce an error.
SSH 服务停止后可能无法重新连接。: You may be unable to reconnect after stopping SSH.
%d 个服务；按 Docker 当前保留的容器统计，未创建或已删除的服务不在清单: %d services; counts only containers currently retained by Docker. Services with no container or deleted containers are omitted. Running does not mean healthy.
%d 个连接引用；删除前需先解除引用。: Used by %d connections. Remove references before deleting.
AI 将可执行任意命令、使用交互终端并修改关键文件；破坏性命令护栏不再生效。: AI will be able to run any command, use an interactive terminal and modify critical files; the destructive-command guardrail no longer applies.
AI 的文件操作不能读取、下载或修改这些路径。每行一个绝对路径；留空使用默认保护: AI file operations cannot read, download, or modify these paths. Enter one absolute path per line; leave empty to use the defaults.
AI 请求会直接拒绝并记入历史: AI requests are denied directly and recorded in history
CPU 使用率按单核计算，多核容器可以超过 100%: CPU usage is measured per core; multicore containers may exceed 100%
Docker 内存口径合计；已采集 %d / %d 个活动容器: Total Docker memory usage; sampled %d / %d active containers
Docker 内存口径（扣除可回收缓存），上限: Docker memory usage (excluding reclaimable cache), limit
Docker 已安装，当前账户无法连接本机 Docker。请检查服务是否运行，以: Docker is installed, but this account cannot connect to it. Check that the service is running and the account has permission.
Docker 清单超出显示上限，已截断: Docker inventory exceeds the display limit and was truncated
FIDO2 / sk- 密钥请选 SSH 密钥代理；此处不导出私钥、不初始化或修: Use SSH key agent for FIDO2 / sk- keys. Private keys are never exported, and tokens are not initialized or modified.
FIDO2 / sk- 请通过 SSH 密钥代理使用。: Use an SSH agent for FIDO2 / sk- keys.
JSON 可粘贴单个节点、节点数组，或含 outbounds 的完整配置。: Paste a single JSON node, a node array, or a full configuration with outbounds.
SSH 中转服务器不可用，请编辑线路: SSH relay unavailable; edit the route
SSH 服务器上的程序经本机，访问本机网络中的目标服务。: Applications on the SSH server reach the destination through this device.
SSH 服务器上的程序通过隧道，访问当前设备上的服务。: Applications on the SSH server reach a service on this device through the tunnel.
SSH 服务器监听 → 本机侧目标: SSH server listener → destination reached locally
SSH 跳板机不可用，请编辑线路: SSH jump host unavailable; edit the route
SSH 跳板线路循环或超过 4 跳: SSH route loops or exceeds four hops
SSH 连接提前关闭，请检查服务器或代理线路后重试: SSH closed early. Check the server or proxy route and retry
SSH 通道已结束，请重新连接: The SSH tunnel has ended. Please reconnect.
SSH：右键目标服务器 → 终端连接 → SOCKS5。其他软件选 SOCKS5: SSH: right-click the target server → Connect terminal → SOCKS5. In other apps, choose SOCKS5 and enter this address.
Snell v4 / v5 使用 TCP 兼容模式，不包含 v5 QUIC。: Snell v4/v5 uses TCP compatibility mode; v5 QUIC is not included.
Snell 支持 v4 / v5 TCP 兼容模式及 v6，仅用于 SSH 中转: Snell supports v4/v5 TCP compatibility mode and v6, for SSH proxying only.
VNC 主机请填写 IP 或域名，端口在右侧单独填写: Enter the VNC IP address or hostname; enter the port separately on the right
VNC 端口需为 1–65535 之间的数字: The VNC port must be a number from 1 to 65535

下次用主密码解锁后生效: Takes effect after the next master-password unlock
下次连接时核对服务器身份: Verify server identity on the next connection
下载镜像并重建所选服务，可能短暂中断: Pull images and recreate selected services; a brief interruption may occur
不修改符号链接权限: Do not change symbolic link permissions
不再等待结果；已发到服务器的操作可能仍会完成: Stop waiting for the result; an action already sent to the server may still complete
不含命令、终端、状态采样或容器日志: Excludes commands, terminals, status sampling and container logs
不能修改或删除根目录: Cannot modify or delete the root directory
与申请端一致再允许: Allow only after checking against the requesting app
与连接一起加密保存；不会返回给调用方: Encrypted with the connection; never returned to callers.
两次主密码不一致: The master passwords do not match
中继会话已结束，请重新选择: Relay session ended. Choose another source.
中转只使用你保存并核对指纹的服务器；最多 4 跳，每跳独立验证，不承诺固定提速。: Relays use your saved, fingerprint-verified servers. Up to four independently verified hops; speed gains vary. A hop can use a proxy or an SSH relay, and only the first physical hop uses a proxy.
中风险文件操作确认开关: Toggle confirmation of medium-risk file actions
为这台电脑上的连接资料设置一个主密码。: Set a master password for connection details on this computer.
请将手指放在指纹读取器上: Place your finger on the fingerprint reader
未识别指纹。请重试或使用保险库主密码。: Fingerprint not recognized. Try again or use the vault password.
主机指纹与已确认记录不一致: The host fingerprint does not match the trusted record
仅 SSH 服务器本机程序可连接此端口: Only applications on the SSH server can connect
仅保留最近日志，较早内容已移出显示缓存: Only recent logs are retained; older entries have left the display buffer
仅删除命令库中的这条记录。: Only this entry will be removed from saved commands.
仅在私钥已加密时填写: Required only for an encrypted private key
仅在私钥文件已加密时填写: Required only for an encrypted private key
仅开放受控文件操作；属性和续传写入关闭: Controlled file operations only; attribute changes and resumed writes are disabled
仅开放授权目录内的文件操作: File operations only within the approved directories
仅支持 TCP；不支持 UDP / BIND: TCP only; UDP / BIND are not supported
仅本机程序可连接此端口: Only applications on this device can connect
仅本次，不扩大或续期会话权限: This operation only; session scope and expiry stay unchanged
仅编辑不含 NUL 的 UTF-8 文本，请下载该文件: Only UTF-8 text without NUL bytes can be edited; download this file instead
仅限授权目录；不含命令、终端、状态采样或容器日志: Authorized directories only; no commands, terminals, status or container logs
仅限明确的回环 IP；端口 0 自动分配，例如 127.0.0.1:0: Use a literal loopback IP. Port 0 selects an available port, for example 127.0.0.1:0.
从 SSH 服务器访问的主机:端口，例如 127.0.0.1:5900。服务器需: Host:port reachable from the SSH server, for example 127.0.0.1:5900. A VNC server must already be running.
从服务器列表中选择一台，或搜索已有服务器。: Choose a server from the list or search your saved servers.
代理身份随保险库保持稳定，首次可信解锁后自动配对；锁定或重启无需再复制指纹。客户: The broker identity stays stable with the vault. The first trusted unlock pairs the CLI automatically. Client sessions remain bound to each live process and connection; reconnecting requires fresh approval.
以后不再提醒（仅这条命令）: Don't ask again for this command
低风险放行 · 中风险确认 · 高风险拒绝: Low: allow · Medium: review · High: deny
使用此 SSH 账户的权限执行: Runs with the permissions of this SSH account
保存到新路径；已有文件不会被覆盖。: Save to a new path; existing files will not be overwritten.
保存新指纹并连接: Save the new fingerprint and connect
保存服务器信息后，即可在工作台连接终端。: Save a server to connect from the workbench.
保护已关闭 · AI 可使用账户全部权限: Protection off · AI can use all account permissions
保护模式不开放此操作: Operation is unavailable with protection on
保护路径不可读取；其余路径仍受账户权限限制: Protected paths cannot be read; account permissions still apply elsewhere
保活关闭时，此项不生效。启用后按所选间隔的倍数等待响应；例如 30 秒 × 3: This setting has no effect while keepalive is off. When enabled, the response deadline is a multiple of the interval: for example, 30 seconds × 3 = 90 seconds. A timeout closes the connection; reconnect manually.
保险库已锁定，请重新解锁后继续: The vault is locked. Unlock it to continue
修改文件权限与所属用户 / 组: Change file permissions and owner / group
停止并移除任务，删除本机未完成的部分文件: Stop and remove the task, deleting its unfinished local partial file
停止并移除任务；服务器上未完成的临时文件不会自动删除: Stop and remove the task; the unfinished temporary file on the server is not deleted automatically
停止当前运行，相关功能将暂时不可用。: Stop the running service. Related features will be temporarily unavailable.
停止此项目已有的服务容器，相关服务将不可用。容器及数据卷保留，每个容器最多等待: Stop existing service containers in this project. Related services will be unavailable. Containers and volumes are retained; each container has up to 10 seconds to exit gracefully.
允许 AI 访问此服务器: Allow AI access to this server
允许本机应用使用此密钥签名: Allow local apps to sign with this key
允许超过 6 小时无人值守的会话: Allow an unattended session longer than 6 hours
先停止再启动，相关功能可能短暂中断。: Stop and start the service. Related features may be briefly interrupted.
先核对指纹；不登录目标服务器。中转会登录已保存的跳板机。: Verify the host fingerprint first. The destination is not authenticated; a saved jump host is authenticated if used.
先核对指纹；不登录目标服务器，只测量连接建立耗时。中转需要登录已保存的跳板机，不: Verify the fingerprint first. The destination is not authenticated to; this measures connection setup only. Relays require authentication to the saved jump host. Results do not measure sustained bandwidth.
入口仅供服务器本机使用。: The entry is available only on the SSH server.
关闭后不会因电脑闲置自动锁定；手动锁定、系统锁屏和休眠仍会结束访问。: When disabled, computer inactivity will not lock the vault. Manual locking, system lock and sleep still end access.
关闭后仍可能需要填写参数或选择系统: Parameters or an operating system may still be required when confirmation is off.
关闭终端、锁定或退出时结束: Ends when the terminal closes, the vault locks, or the app quits
关闭面板不中断任务: Closing the panel keeps tasks running
关闭面板不中断任务；取消或移除只删除未完成的部分文件: Closing keeps tasks running; cancel or remove deletes only unfinished partial files
关闭面板不中断任务；清理记录不删除文件: Closing keeps tasks running; clearing records keeps files
内容超过记录上限；操作摘要可用于核对原始请求: Content exceeded the record limit; compare the operation hash with the original request
内置编辑器支持 4 MiB 以内、不含 NUL 的 UTF-8 文本；图片、PD: The editor supports UTF-8 text up to 4 MiB without NUL bytes. Download images, PDFs, archives and other binary files to open them.
分组不能超过 128 字节或包含换行: Group names cannot exceed 128 bytes or contain a newline
切换停靠位置与面板大小: Change dock position and panel size
删除前需解除这些连接的引用。: Remove these connections’ references before deleting.
删除后无法从客户端恢复；目录必须为空。: Deleted items cannot be restored from this app; directories must be empty.
删除后无法从此工具恢复: Cannot be restored from this tool after deletion
删除后无法恢复。已部署的公钥需从服务器移除。: Deletion cannot be undone. Remove the deployed public key from your servers.
删除后无法恢复。正在被连接引用的线路不能删除。: Deletion cannot be undone. A route still referenced by a connection cannot be deleted.
删除本机连接资料及已保存凭据，撤销现有授权。该连接的编辑标签会关闭，未保存内容会: Delete local connection details and saved credentials, and revoke existing grants. Editor tabs for this connection will close and unsaved changes will be lost. Files on the server are retained.
剪贴板里没有私钥文本: No private key text on the clipboard
功能区已独立为标签页，可拖回此处停靠: Tools are open in workspace tabs. Drag a tab here to dock it.
加载驱动并读取令牌 / 公钥: Load provider and list tokens / public keys
单核口径合计，可超过 100%%；已采集 %d / %d 个活动容器: Total per-core CPU usage may exceed 100%%; sampled %d / %d active containers
历史仅记录已发送的单行输入，最多 512 字节: History remembers sent single-line inputs up to 512 bytes
历史随保险库加密保存；敏感参数可关闭记录: History is encrypted with the vault; disable it for sensitive parameters
原终端已关闭，命令未发送: The original terminal is closed; the command was not sent
原连接已关闭，请重新选择操作目标: The original connection is closed. Select an operation target again
原连接已关闭，请重新选择更新目标: The original connection is closed. Select an update target again
参数历史正在保存，请稍后再试: Input history is being saved. Try again shortly.
取消勾选则一直保留到你选择的时长: Untick to keep it for the whole duration
取消自启设置。当前运行的服务继续运行，仍可能由其他服务唤起。: Disable autostart. The running service will continue and may still be started by other services.
受保护路径禁止读取、下载和修改: Protected paths cannot be read, downloaded or modified
只使用已保存并核对指纹的服务器；每跳独立验证，最多 4 跳。: Use saved servers with verified fingerprints. Each hop is verified separately, up to four hops.
只提取支持的出站节点；整份 JSON 中的监听、DNS、路由与服务配置不会导入。: Only supported outbound nodes are extracted. Listeners, DNS, routing and services are not imported. Input is never logged.
只更新当前用户的代理身份信任，不授予服务器访问权限。已有不同身份的配对会被替换。: Update broker trust for the current user. This grants no server access. Any previously paired identity will be replaced.
只移除记录，不删除文件: Remove the record without deleting files
只能编辑普通文件；符号链接请打开目标文件: Only regular files can be edited; open the target of a symbolic link
只读取公钥供选择，私钥由密钥代理保管: Only public keys are read for selection; private keys stay in the SSH agent
可使用此 SSH 账户的全部权限，包括任意命令和文件修改: May use all permissions of this SSH account, including arbitrary commands and file changes
可先留空读取设备，再选择令牌后输入 PIN；不会遍历尝试 PIN: Leave blank to list devices first. Select a token before entering its PIN; the PIN is never tried across tokens.
可在容器内执行任意命令: May run arbitrary commands inside the container
可执行任意命令和修改文件: May run arbitrary commands and modify files
可读取此账户有权访问的所有路径: May read every path this account can access
合并 CPU 和内存占用最高的各 32 个进程；进程 CPU 来自 ps，可超过: Combined top 32 processes by CPU and by memory. Process CPU comes from ps and may exceed 100% (multiple cores).
同项目容器的配置来源不一致，请先在服务器核对: Containers in this project have conflicting configuration sources. Check them on the server first
名称由申请端提供，未经身份验证: The requesting app supplied this name; its identity is unverified
名称由申请端提供，请核对配对码: The requesting app supplied this name. Check the pairing code
含自动读取 CPU、内存、进程、服务和 Docker 状态: Includes automatic reads of CPU, memory, processes, services, and Docker status
启动后，在需要代理的应用中选择 SOCKS5，填入 %s。: After starting, select SOCKS5 in your application and use %s.
启动后，服务器上的程序可通过入口端口访问本机服务。: After starting, programs on the server can use the entry port to access your local service.
启动此项目已有的服务容器，不创建容器或升级镜像。已暂停的容器不会自动解除暂停。: Start existing service containers in this project without creating containers or upgrading images. Paused containers will remain paused.
启用后，客户端会定时发送很小的 SSH 探测请求，帮助维持空闲连接，并发现无响应: When enabled, the client periodically sends small SSH probe requests to help keep idle connections alive and detect an unresponsive connection. When disabled, no probes are sent; the server or network devices may still close an idle connection.
命令已发送，但参数历史未保存：: Command sent, but input history was not saved:
命令已发送，参数历史队列已满: Command sent; input history queue is full
回环监听可被同一机器上的其他进程使用。SOCKS5 可访问任意 TCP 目标；不: Other processes on the same machine can use a loopback listener. SOCKS5 can access any TCP destination; UDP and BIND are unsupported. Tunnels run in the background. Locking, quitting, revoking, or stopping closes listeners and accepted connections.
在本机开一个端口，通过 SSH 访问远端服务。: Open a local port to reach a remote service through SSH.
在本机打开此入口，即可访问远端服务。: Open this local entry to access the remote service.
在标签页打开文件管理: Open file manager in a tab
地址或端口已变化，请重新连接并核对身份: Address or port changed. Reconnect and verify the server identity
备注最多 8 KiB，不能包含控制字符: Notes are limited to 8 KiB and cannot contain control characters
复用此连接的 SSH 登录信息和代理线路，并核对已保存的 SSH 主机身份。VN: Uses this connection’s SSH credentials, proxy route and saved SSH host identity. Enter VNC credentials in the remote desktop window. Closing the window or locking disconnects the session.
外部客户端需固定此公钥；锁定或重启后重新核对。会话断线或进程退出后不能恢复。: External clients must pin this key. Verify it again after locking or restarting. Disconnected sessions cannot be restored.
多行命令请使用发送并执行: Use Send and run for multiline commands
安装更新、重启及写入需另行授权: Installation, restarts, and writes require separate approval
定时探测连接，帮助维持空闲连接并发现断连。关闭后不再发送探测。: Periodically probe the connection to keep it alive and detect disconnection. Turning this off stops the probes.
审计历史无法验证：记录已被修改或删除: Audit verification failed: records were modified or removed
容器内的服务会中断。先请求正常停止，10 秒后仍未退出会强制结束。: Services inside the container will be interrupted. Request a graceful stop, then force termination after 10 seconds if it has not exited.
容器清单不完整，无法确认项目范围，请刷新后重试: The container inventory is incomplete, so the project scope cannot be verified. Refresh and retry
容器资源最短每 10 秒、清单最短每分钟更新；读取失败时会退避重试。: Container resources refresh at most every 10 seconds and inventory every minute; failures use retry backoff.
将删除 %d 项；目录必须为空。: Delete %d items? Folders must be empty.
将拉取镜像并重建所选服务，可能短暂中断。: Images will be pulled and selected services recreated. A brief interruption may occur.
尚未读取各核心数据: Per-core data has not been loaded
尚未读取文件系统容量: Filesystem capacity has not been loaded
尚未读取系统服务信息: System service information has not been loaded
尚未采样端口信息: Port information has not been sampled yet
已停止等待，服务器可能仍在处理；请检查状态: Stopped waiting; the server may still be processing. Check its status.
已停止等待，请核对服务器实际状态: Stopped waiting. Check the actual server state
已加密保存，正在连接终端…: Encrypted and saved. Connecting to terminal…
已按本次握手测量选择路径；保存连接后生效: Path selected from this measurement. Save the connection to apply it.
已提取 %d 个支持的节点，请选择要保存的线路。原始输入已清除。: Extracted %d supported nodes. Choose a route to save. The original input has been cleared.
已用 = 总量 − 可用；可用包含可回收缓存，缓存与其他项并非互斥。: Used = Total − Available. Available includes reclaimable cache; cache and other categories may overlap.
已锁定，连接与授权已撤销；审计锚点未写入: Locked; connections and grants revoked. The audit anchor was not written
常用命令已保存，但列表刷新失败：: Saved the command, but refreshing the list failed:

选择网络代理或自有 SSH 中转，并比较连接路径。: Choose a network proxy or your own SSH relay and compare routes.
选择账户名称，或输入数字 UID/GID: Select an account name or enter a numeric UID/GID
选择默认代理线路或 SSH 跳板机；右键可临时选用线路。: Choose a default proxy route or SSH jump host; right-click to select a route for one session.
通知区域图标不可用，窗口将保持打开：%s: Notification area icon unavailable; the window will stay open: %s
通过此连接的默认线路建立 SSH 通道，由 SSH 服务器访问 VNC 地址；V: Creates an SSH tunnel using this connection’s default route. The SSH server accesses the VNC host; use 127.0.0.1 if VNC listens only on that server’s loopback interface.
部分记录无法解析: Some records could not be parsed
部分进程信息不可见: Some process information is not visible
重启此项目全部已有服务，包括当前已停止的服务；会短暂中断，不升级镜像或应用配置变: Restart all existing services in this project, including stopped ones. This briefly interrupts service and does not upgrade images or apply configuration changes. Each container gets up to 10 seconds to exit normally.
锁定、退出或撤销后失效: Expires on lock, exit, or revocation
锁定后可用 %s 解锁；开机、更新或 48 小时后需主密码。凭据只在本机后台内存: After a lock, unlock with %s. Restarts, updates and 48 hours require the master password. The credential lives only in the local service's memory and is never written to disk.
非回环包含内网与通配地址，不代表公网可达。外部连接按对端非回环地址归类，不推断连: Non-loopback includes private and wildcard addresses and does not imply public reachability. External connections have non-loopback peers; the initiating direction is not inferred. UDP entries show bindings or current peers.
项目已不在当前 Docker 清单中，请返回项目列表。: The project is no longer in the current Docker inventory. Return to the project list.
项目操作范围过大，无法生成完整确认请求: The project action scope is too large to generate a complete confirmation request
项目来源标签不完整，请刷新 Docker 清单后重试: Project source labels are incomplete. Refresh the Docker inventory and try again
预览仅核对配置，尚未拉取镜像；更新后核对运行与健康状态。: Preview checks configuration only; images have not been pulled. Running and health status will be checked after the update.
首次按服务要求登录，可保存 VNC 密码；下次相同目标自动填入。密码保存在加密保: Save your VNC password after the first successful login to use it automatically for the same target. It is encrypted in the vault. Locking disconnects the remote desktop.
驱动会以当前用户执行原生代码，只选择可信模块；支持 PKCS#11 RSA /: Providers execute native code as the current user. Load trusted modules only. PKCS#11 RSA / ECDSA is supported; FIDO2 uses an agent.
驻留仍由本应用进程提供；彻底退出后授权和任务会结束。: The app process remains running. Quitting the app ends authorizations and tasks.
驻留时请至少保留一个恢复入口: Keep at least one way to reopen the running app
驻留隐藏相关窗口；退出会锁定连接。: Residency hides related windows; quitting locks connections.
高占用进程 %d 项 · CPU 为进程运行期间平均值: %d high-usage processes · CPU is averaged over each process''s lifetime
默认 5900，可改为 VNC 服务实际使用的 TCP 端口。: Defaults to 5900. Change it to the TCP port used by the VNC service.
默认当前服务器的 IP 或域名，端口在下方单独填写。: Defaults to this server’s IP address or hostname. Enter the port separately below.
